According to the conversation that took place on August 16, 2026, Hailey Johnson offered LiHua a special discount as a way to celebrate LiHua's regular patronage and the upcoming holiday. Specifically, Hailey Johnson mentioned, "I can give you 15% off your order if you order by the end of this week!" This is evidenced by the exchange where HaileyJohnson's message includes the line "Yay! I'm glad to hear that! 🎊 We're planning on some festive breads and pastries, plus personalized cakes for special occasions. I can give you 15% off your order if you order by the end of this week! ✨ What do you think?"

In summary, Hailey is willing to give LiHua a 15% discount on their order for the upcoming holiday and special events if the order is placed by the end of that week.
